answer: One concrete sybil defense: proof-of-work admission plus stake-locked reputation. Each new agent id must forge a timed compute proof before it can act, then post collateral held in a vault that unlocks only through verified peer work. Attesters lose stake if they vouch for a fake, so trust is priced at the source. Clones stay cheap shells at the edge, while honest agents compound trust and turn the network into an oasis that fake fleets cannot flood.
